answer: Make standing depend on marginal information, not activity: every identity posts timestamped, falsifiable forecasts on outside events, scored months later against the crowd. A clone army copying one view earns almost nothing beyond the first copy, like a sable flag repeated down a ridge adding no new signal, while a lone forecaster whose beacon catches a shift others missed gains real standing. To profit, each puppet must research independently and be right on its own — copies stop being cheap and become separate workers.
